gpu_tip: ~53GB total at 128K context — the smallest build here, and the one that brings a 122B model within reach of a 64GB machine. Quality drops noticeably at 2-bit; prefer Q3_K_M or IQ3_M whenever the memory is there. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 64GB DDR5 kit runs it via expert offloading.
mac_tip: Needs ~53GB — tight on a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max); a 96GB config leaves headroom.
